text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Did I wake you up?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... it's too early to wake up. Sleep... 
is still right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Please sleep a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a second, I was left dumbfounded by 
what was happening in front of me. This is 
my home... in the morning, and barely past 
dawn at that... yet...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Ah... You've woken up, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped... Coffee... No, would 
some slightly sweet... warm tea be better?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'll go brew some, so please... wait just 
a moment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, Manhattan Cafe and I parted 
ways after training with a simple, "Good 
work today, see you tomorrow." Or so I 
thought.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Why... is it in this room? It should have 
been locked, and I have no memory of her 
visiting.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet, as if it were the most natural 
thing in the world— she's right here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to resolve that doubt, but 
something blocked my thoughts, saying, 
'There's no need. Don't think about it.'

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you... not feeling well?
choice_data_list: （……What time is it now, I wonder?）

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Where are you heading?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You seem exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You don't look well. Could you be 
pushing yourself too hard...?
choice_data_list:
...Are you... in the middle of training 
right now?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Fatigue has caught up with you after 
all. Please... get some rest."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Come, lie down... on that bench over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But... it's too early to wake up. Sleep... 
is still right beside me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the scene I saw just moments ago. 
Was I half-asleep... No, but... ...I don't 
understand. What is happening?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Please sleep a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe

...You don't look well. Could you be 
pushing yourself too hard...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe

"...Fatigue has caught up with you after 
all. Please... get some rest."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Come, lie down... on that bench over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It repeats. The same scene, with the 
same voices."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Time and time again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Taking a single word as a cue.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Good morning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather than fear... a feeling of regret 
that "I messed up" wells up inside. And 
along with it, a heavy sigh escapes.
choice_data_list:
I'm contracted with a cafe, so I'm pretty 
used to it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Please sleep a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Yes. Good night, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...... Yes... Please, reflect on what 
you've done.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Now then—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe?
text_block_list.text: Sweet dreams... ...Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
………… ...Trainer... seemed so busy 
yesterday, too...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Are you... getting enough rest, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...'She won't be waking up for a while'? 
'Left behind in the dream'..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“...I... I see. ...You were worried too, 
weren't you...?”

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. For now, let's just let them... rest 
peacefully.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When it's time to wake up, I'll brew some 
coffee... and we'll go welcome it 
together.
